description: Low-Head Dam GIS Data is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Quintana, Kenneth Thomas (deposited on HydroShare). Data used to screen for submerged hydraulic jumps at low-head dams. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2025-12-29 and last updated 2026-01-05; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
